name: Imperial Hotel Osaka
positioning: Riverside city hotel beside the Okawa River in Osaka's Kita-ku, with suites looking east toward the Ikoma mountains
best_for: Travelers who want river views from a city hotel
Guests who want a large fitness club with a pool, saunas and tennis courts

facts.text: The hotel is at 8-50 Temmabashi 1-chome in Osaka's Kita-ku.
The Imperial Hotel Plaza shopping arcade lies along the bank of the Okawa River, part of Osaka Amenity Park.
The Imperial Floors, on floors 19 to 21, hold the hotel's highest-grade rooms.
The Imperial Floor Lounge is for the exclusive use of Imperial Floor guests and suite guests.
Regular Floor Superior rooms look down on the riverside nature, which changes with the seasons.
Imperial Floor Deluxe rooms have the Imperial Hotel's original bed and duvet.
The hotel's facilities include a pool and saunas.
The fitness club has tennis courts.
The fitness club has a golf practice course.
The restaurants and bar lounges serve French cuisine, a long tradition of the hotel, as well as Japanese, teppanyaki and Chinese cuisine.
Les Saisons, the fine French restaurant, is on the 23rd floor.
The hotel shop carries Doorman Snoopy goods, confectionery, breads and deli items.

highlights.text: From the east-facing windows of the Imperial Floor Suites you can see the distant ridgelines of the Ikoma mountain range and, below, the Okawa River.
The Regular Floor Suite offers a 180-degree river view.
The fitness club has an open, resort-like interior with plenty of natural light and greenery, across a total floor area of 4,400 square meters.
The Imperial Floor Junior Suites have a mist sauna.
The concierge team has assembled programs ranging from traditional Japanese cultural experiences to sightseeing tours.

considerations.text: Hotel guests pay an entrance fee to use the fitness club's pool, bath area and sauna.
The fitness club cannot be used by persons with tattoos.
The fitness center, pool and saunas close for maintenance on the third Tuesday of every month.
